# CryptoHawking DEX

> A free, testnet-only decentralised exchange on Base Sepolia (chain ID 84532) where anyone can
> launch, pool, farm and trade their own valueless test tokens. Swap (v2 AMM, v3 concentrated
> liquidity, Infinity singleton), liquidity provision and farming rails. No real funds, ever.

Site: https://dex.cryptohawking.com
Developers guide: https://dex.cryptohawking.com/developers
Source: https://github.com/mudaseriqbalshah/crypthawking.dex

## Network

- Network: Base Sepolia testnet (testnet only — no mainnet deployment)
- Chain ID: 84532
- RPC: https://sepolia.base.org
- Explorer: https://sepolia.basescan.org
- Token list: https://dex.cryptohawking.com/cryptohawking.tokenlist.json

## How to launch your own test token on Base Sepolia

1. Get free Base Sepolia gas ETH from https://portal.cdp.coinbase.com/products/faucet or
   https://www.alchemy.com/faucets/base-sepolia
2. Claim free test tokens (HAWK, tUSDC, tUSDT, tDAI, tWBTC) at https://dex.cryptohawking.com/faucet
   — one claim() call drips all five, 24h cooldown.
3. Deploy a standard ERC-20 to chain 84532 with Remix (https://remix.ethereum.org) or copy the
   reference TestERC20 from the GitHub repo above.
4. Create a pool: v2 pair via HawkingRouter.addLiquidity, or a v3 concentrated-liquidity position
   via the NonfungiblePositionManager. Add liquidity in the UI at
   https://dex.cryptohawking.com/liquidity/positions or /add.
5. Trade it at https://dex.cryptohawking.com/swap using "import token by address".
